frequency_question: What proportion of regulatory capital buffer adjustments completed all procedural steps within a 4-month (118-day) window once initiated?
membership_rule: Includes all macroprudential capital buffer level adjustments proposed and finalized by major central banking authorities; excludes emergency weekend interventions.

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional

known_gaps: Internal board discussions lack public timestamps, though administrative procedures act as a strict lower bound.
skeleton: Regulatory rulemakings involving public notice, comment periods, and board votes typically require a minimum structural timeline of 6 to 18 months from initial proposal to final effective date.
multiplier: 1 proposal step * average duration of 9 months / 4 month available window
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act and central bank governance rules change slowly over multi-decade horizons.
